create_sinusoid_position_encoding: create sinusoidal positional encodings for a transformer sequence with given length and hidden size
apply_rotary_encoding: apply rotary positional encoding (RoPE) to query or key tensors in a transformer model
compute_attention_with_relative_encoding: compute attention logits with Transformer-XL style relative positional encodings
compute_alibi_encodings_biases: compute ALiBi linear bias matrix for multi-head attention without positional embeddings
compute_noisy_alibi_encodings_biases: compute ALiBi biases with randomly sampled positions from a wider range for robustness
